meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 技能被调用后，会先问清你想要什么改法，然后按方案修改 NanoClaw——例如添加 Telegram/Slack 输入渠道、改触发规则、接 MCP 工具，最后告诉你如何重启验证。
howto.when: 当你想加渠道（Telegram、Slack 等）、改触发规则、加集成，或做其他定制时，它会先提问确认需求。

say.text: 帮我接入 Telegram，让消息能发进来并回复。
say.note: 会先跑 /add-telegram，再问你接到哪个群组。

say.text: 把某个群组的助手人设改成简洁风格。
say.note: 它会定位到对应群组的 CLAUDE.md 去改。

say.text: 加一个日历 MCP 工具，只给指定群用。

howto.what_en: On activation, this skill asks clarifying questions, then applies the change to the right surface (entity model, container config, CLAUDE.md, or core code), e.g. adding channels, changing triggers, wiring MCP integrations, and tells the user how to verify.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, or make other customizations, it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel so it replies to messages.
say_en.note: Runs /add-telegram, then asks which agent group.

say_en.text: Change one agent group's persona to a concise style.
Add a calendar MCP tool for one specific group.
say_en.note: It may use /add-gcal-tool or add an MCP server.
